name: Runtime Source
description: Builds a host's minqlxtended from a repository you choose instead of the commit QLSM pins, for example the alexeytihomirov/minqlxtended fork that native demo capture needs. Enable it for a host, enter the repository and a commit, then run Re-run Host Setup. Needs a QLSM whose host setup supports a custom minqlxtended repository on every provider (host.setup hook).

host.label: Repository URL
host.description: An https:// git URL without credentials. Must stay plugin-compatible with minqlxtended: the host keeps the minqlxtended plugin pool, paths and presets.

host.label: Commit, tag or branch
host.description: Pin a commit: a branch builds whatever it holds on the day setup runs. Leave both fields blank to build the commit QLSM pins.

host_source.description: Where this host's minqlxtended is built from. Takes effect on the next Re-run Host Setup, not on save. Ignored on a minqlx host.
